# Built-ins of Claude Code

This page lists each built-in part of Claude Code 2.1.302, its levers, and what claudetto does with it.
A script writes it from the strings of the Claude Code bundle, and `--check` fails when a new release shows a new part.
Run `bun tools/builtins.ts` to write the pages, and `bun tools/builtins.ts --check` to find a difference.
The size of a part is the count of bytes of its static text in the bundle, with the text of the constants and the functions that it names.
A dash means that the bundle holds no text for the part.

## Groups

`NAME` in a lever is the name of the part.
A group with a link has a page of its own.

| Group | Parts | Without a verdict | Lever to turn off | Lever to replace |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- | --- |
| [commands](Builtins-Commands) | 109 | 107 | `command.describe` `{ command: "NAME" }` answers `next({ ...e, isHidden: true })` | `command.run` `{ command: "NAME" }` answers `{ text }` or `{}` |
| plugins | 12 | 12 | `enabledPlugins` `"cc-plugin-NAME@builtin": false` (`"NAME@builtin"` works too since 2.1.285) | a plugin of claudetto |
| [attachments](Builtins-Attachments) | 116 | 116 | `prompt.attachment` `{ type: "NAME" }` answers `{ text: null }` | `prompt.attachment` `{ type: "NAME" }` answers `{ text }` |
| sections | 36 | 36 | `prompt.section` `{ name: "NAME" }` answers `{ text: null }` | `prompt.section` `{ name: "NAME" }` answers `{ text }`, or `prompt.compose` |
| [tools](Builtins-Tools) | 85 | 85 | `permissions.deny`, or `tool.call` `{ tool: "NAME" }` answers `{ deny }` | `tool.describe` `{ tool: "NAME" }`, or `$.tool.register` for a new tool |
| agents | 7 | 7 | `agent.offer` `{ agent: "NAME" }` answers `{ isOffered: false }`, or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_PLAN_AGENTS` | `$.agent.register` |
| compaction | 1 | 1 | `DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT` | `session.compact` answers with its own `messages` |
| attribution | 1 | 1 | the `attribution` setting | `attribution.text` `{ kind: "commit" }` or `{ kind: "pr" }` |
| git | 1 | 1 | `includeGitInstructions: false` | `prompt.section` or `prompt.context` |
| statusline | 1 | 1 | no `statusLine` setting | the `statusLine` command |
| skills | 33 | 33 | `skillOverrides` `"NAME": "off"`, or `disableBundledSkills`, or `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS` | `skill.prompt` `{ skill: "NAME" }` |
| servertools | 1 | 0 | `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` | `$.tool.register`, because no hook can refuse or rewrite a server tool |
